hypothesis: Replacing the player's standalone pass-attempt count forecast with a team-attempt pool and a starter-specific share estimated from past verified starts improves matched QB count CRPS.
activation_requirements: Independent Phase 1 evaluator acceptance for NFL pass attempts with original-byte evidence
Signed Phase 1.5 NFL error-priority memo showing enough pregame allocation evidence to justify this bounded mechanism
Immutable verified event, explicit league-source starter identity, model/feature provenance, and point-in-time history available for the precommitted cohort
Independent approval and pinning of the exact code, prior and challenger versions, source adapter, and first eligible origin before accessing any pilot outcomes
eligible_universe: NFL regular-season full-game player pass attempts including overtime. Keep all official team-games, candidate QBs and real offers with explicit reasons for all skips. Count scoring uses one independently confirmed starting QB per team-game with verified played status and valid official count. Real-offer scoring is secondary and requires exact original two-sided terms, line, and DNP/push convention.
baseline: Simple empirical player prior over the last eight verified earlier starts, minimum four, equal weights. Forecast the empirical pass-attempt count PMF. Record original frozen V1 separately wherever comparable.
challenger: Empirical team pass-attempt pool over last eight verified earlier team games, minimum four. For each pool draw allocate N attempts by a binomial probability equal to (1 + sum of starter attempts) / (2 + sum of team attempts) over the same starter-history games used by the prior, bound starter attempts by team attempts and retain the residual bucket T - N. No market conditioning or extra fitted feature.
cutoff_policy: Every training observation must have a verified official result available strictly before entry to the event's pregame freeze. Team-game and starter histories use only verified official identities and results. Require an exact-identity signed or source-bound original explicit starter claim before freeze, at most six hours old, and reject projection, depth-chart-only, contradictory and post-kickoff source claims.

cohort_and_splits.first_origin: First untouched eligible slate after activation is documented
cohort_and_splits.horizon: First four NFL regular-season weeks from first origin, analysis once after official settlement. No outcome-dependent extension.
cohort_and_splits.minimum_for_investment: At least 24 matched unique games and eight distinct dates; report feasibility and retain baseline if either minimum or interval criterion fails.
cohort_and_splits.resampling: 10000 paired whole-date bootstrap replicates, seed 20261124; report whole-game sensitivity and individual week results

primary_metric: Challenger minus player prior empirical count CRPS, equal date weight; 95 percent paired interval
secondary_metrics: MAE and signed mean error by game, team, and low versus high starter share
Availability, coverage, zero/tail errors, conservation and runtime
Three-way Brier/log loss on exact matched real contracts, when available
negative_controls: future or same-origin official result sentinel
future, stale, wrong-team, duplicate, contradictory and unofficial starter claim
absent QB, unverified participant, and actual stake/DNP/push semantics
permuted starter identities within training weeks, descriptive only
exact count PMF normalization and zero illegal or overallocated draws
investment_rule: Require all integrity gates, no illegal allocations, paired CRPS upper confidence limit below zero, no material loss in matched or attempted coverage, and no material adverse zero/tail, latency or official grading failure. Independently review before funding further work.
rollback_rule: Keep or revert to simple player prior if evidence is missing, interval inconclusive, coverage degraded or any integrity failure occurs. No production wiring or publishing.
artifact_manifest: At activation record exact 40-hex code SHA, experiment card SHA, source and model artifact SHAs, origin roster, source availability and freeze clocks, immutable PMFs, candidate/abstention/reject ledger, official outcomes as separate artifact, seeds/runtime and independent review receipt.
